summary: The Interstate Ambulance is one of the 21 vehicles that can be spawned with a cheat in the released game.
body: PowerPyx, Press Start, Game Rant and Screen Rant all list a spawn cheat for the Interstate Ambulance; PowerPyx says cheats only work once the story is finished and the unlock condition is met.

GTABase's cheat page treats it as an ambulance; its vehicle database has a separate page titled just "Ambulance" (maker Brute, Emergency class), and it is not clear whether that is the same vehicle.
GTABase lists 4 seats and AWD drive for the Interstate Ambulance.
The Declasse Ambulance is an emergency vehicle listed in the released game's vehicle database (era 1990s Classic).
DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Emergency Vehicles.
DayOne gives its stats as speed 3.0, acceleration 2.6, asphalt handling 2.9, off-road handling 2.9, strength 3.0.
GTA Wiki's Ambulance page (edited November 19, 2026) says the GTA VI ambulance is made by Declasse, where earlier games' ambulances were Brute models, and shows one in Fast Pass EMS livery.

name: Hauners Rhino Tank
summary: The Hauners Rhino Tank is one of the 21 vehicles that can be spawned with a cheat in the released game.
body: PowerPyx, Press Start, Game Rant and Screen Rant all list a spawn cheat for the Hauners Rhino Tank; PowerPyx says cheats only work once the story is finished and the unlock condition is met.
Those lists give the unlock condition as: complete all survival challenges.
GTABase's GTA VI database files it under the Military class with Hauners as the maker.
PowerPyx says military tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, an island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, and that stealing one brings an instant 3-star wanted level.
PowerPyx adds that tanks are too big to store as a personal vehicle, and that stealing one earns the Challenging Tank trophy, whose description calls them Rhinos.
DayOne's list from the released game names it and files it under Service - Military Vehicles.
IGN says a Rhino can be stolen as early as Chapter 1 from Mile Zero Air Station, where tanks are parked across the base, two groups of them in its south-west.

IGN says being spotted near the base brings a Wanted level and entering it up to four stars, while a six-star level cannot be lost and ends in being Wasted. PowerPyx, cited in this entry, says a tank theft gives an instant three stars.

IGN's route uses the Mile Zero Air Station South Stunt Jump, which it calls the only way over the unbreakable perimeter fence from the ground near the tanks, and it says to leave through either gate house, the only gaps in the fence.
IGN says R1 fires the tank's cannon, which turns independently of the direction of travel.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 0.8, Acceleration 0.2, Asphalt handling 1.0, Off-road handling 2.8, Strength 8.0, as read by GTABase only so far.
